feature: ordinary Channel Health Watch terminal state and publication wakeup

reference.contract: RecvTrailingMetadataReadyLocked maps UNIMPLEMENTED to READY and disables health checking; SERVING reports READY; non-serving reports TRANSIENT_FAILURE

behavior.unimplemented: publishes SERVING once and returns from the Watch worker; later calls keep passing the health gate until endpoint replacement or Channel teardown
behavior.publication: the waiting owner snapshots the generation before scanning states, and checks that same generation before and after resetting its wake Event
behavior.retry: UNKNOWN endpoints remain excluded; a healthy sibling is still selectable
behavior.ownership: heap-owned Sync stays stable when the Channel value moves; its single waiting owner is the ordinary Channel

grpc_cpp_debug.existing_matrix: shared unary/duplex, bounded operations, keepalive, ORCA, metadata, compression, cancellation, deadlines, RPC/channel soak, HTTP CONNECT, SOCKS5 and pick-first failover

regressions: real h2c peer returns UNIMPLEMENTED; worker completion is joined under a three-second bound; two unary calls reuse one application connection and both health APIs stay true
publication between scan and wait returns without parking for bounded and unbounded RPCs
publication at the futex wait boundary is observed
wait cancellation preserves Canceled and does not invent a health update

verification_commands: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='health gate' -Dtest-filter='reconnecting health Watch' --summary all
remaining_scope: Broader composite/xDS integration and long-duration production stability evidence remain open for the overall goal.
